title: Pre-proof hook validates only the files a commit authors

sha_binding.verified_source_note: Last commit on this branch touching a non-proof path. Re-anchored for Bounce 1: the P1 cross-repository fail-open fix moved the anchor from 69b69d528b3919c072e529d4e23a5490690cb1c4. merge_sha is null pre-merge as the shared evidence contract requires (CEP-E7); it is bound to the real merge commit by post-merge-lane-close.yml.

verdict.statement: The pre-proof validator now validates the files a commit authors, in the repository that commit targets. Inherited-unchanged content is exempt; every other path -- including a conflict resolved to bytes equal to one parent, a post-merge edit, a delete, and a rename -- is still validated. Global options that select a repository (-C, --git-dir, --work-tree) are resolved and honoured, and commit forms whose target cannot be safely resolved are refused rather than guessed. Three pre-existing fail-open gaps were closed; two further fail-opens introduced or missed by earlier rounds -- shell-wrapped command detection and cross-repository resolution -- were found in adversarial review and PM review respectively, and fixed in-lane.

verify.test_live_db_leg: REFUSED locally by ci:assert-staging under production containment (SUPABASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:1); the writable-DB receipt is produced inside the required CI verify job against staging xskgrzbteyqdufktjrjx, which is the only sanctioned source.

mutation_controls.name: PR #1453 regression allows inherited history while the legacy staged-file mutation blocks it
mutation_controls.mutation: Replace the # BEGIN/END MERGE-AWARE SELECTION block with the pre-fix `git diff --cached --name-only` selection.

mutation_controls.name: the raw-command fallback is load-bearing for untokenizable commands
mutation_controls.mutation: Delete the raw-command fallback block; drive it with `git commit -m "unterminated`, which shlex cannot lex.

mutation_controls.name: cross-repository resolution is load-bearing, not decorative
mutation_controls.mutation: Remove the -C application from target resolution so the hook resolves from its own cwd, reproducing the reported P1 shape.

round_1.finding: Argv tokenization silently stopped engaging on shell-wrapped commits (bash -c / sh -c / eval) that the prior substring match caught. Fixed in-lane.

round_2.trigger: PM review, Bounce 1, P1 cross-repository fail-open
round_2.reproduced_before_fix: cwd A, invalid proof staged only in B, `git -C <B> commit -m test` -> exit 0
covered: -C into a path containing a space

scope_refusals: package.json was not touched; scripts/ops/proof-check.test.ts was already wired into test:ops.
UTV2-1729 evidence was not modified and is not special-cased.
No proof-schema weakening, no workflow change, no branch-protection change, no --no-verify or equivalent bypass.
known_gaps: A git alias for commit (e.g. a user-configured `git ci`) is not detected. This is unchanged from the pre-fix hook and outside the authorized scope of this lane.

Because unresolvable targets are now refused, an ordinary shell command whose text contains `git -C <path> commit` for a path that does not exist is blocked as well. This is the conservative branch behaving as specified; it was observed live during this lane and is covered by regressions.
